## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Server impact

Explain compatibility, performance, security, configuration, and migration effects.

## Validation

- [ ] `./gradlew clean build`
- [ ] `./gradlew clean build -PapiLine=modern` on JDK 25
- [ ] New/changed behavior has automated coverage
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated
- [ ] No webhook URL, token, or private player content is included
